summary: An ERC-20 approval exceeding the exact amount a stake pulls in the same atomic batch, with no protocol function needing the excess, is functionally unlimited; insecure under R-4.5.
---

Insecure under R-4.5. The Safe 0x888614448eb7c766864fafb1dd20ff0b47988a87 on Ethereum Mainnet (chain ID 1) delegate calls MultiSendCallOnly 1.4.1 to approve 15000e18 of token 0x5afe3855358e112b5647b952709e6165e1c1eeee to the Staking contract 0x115e78f160e1e3ef163b05c84562fa16fa338509, and to stake 12600e18 there. The Staking source, verified by Sourcify against the code at block 26239438 (observed 2026-10-21), shows that stake pulls exactly the amount it is given, and no function of the contract needs the 2400e18 excess. In the Safe's history, its approvals whose use is shown were exact, including its earlier approve-and-stake on this contract (§ 2.9). The approval's amount materially exceeds what the stated interaction plausibly needs, so it is functionally unlimited (§ 2.5, § 3.7, § 3.8). This sets as precedent under § 5.1: an approval that exceeds the deterministic amount of the interaction it serves, with no protocol function justifying the excess, is functionally unlimited under R-4.5, whatever its relative size.
